chunks: Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Hashimi in Kufa told us, saying: Furat ibn Ibrahim ibn Furat al-Kufi told us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mu'mmar told us, saying: Ahmad ibn Ali al-Ramli told us, saying: Muhammad ibn Musa told us, saying: Ya'qub ibn Ishaq al-Maruzi told us, saying: Amru ibn Mansur told us, saying: Isma'il ibn Aban, from Yahya ibn Kathir, from his father, from Abu Harun al-Abdi, saying: I asked Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari

about the meaning of the saying of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family) to Ali (peace be upon him): 'You are to me in the same position as Harun to Musa, except that there is no Prophet after me.' He said: He appointed him as Successor by that, by Allah, over his nation during his life and after his demise, and He obligated upon them his obedience. Hence, the one who does not testify for him, after this saying, Successorship, then he is among the wrongdoers.

key_terms.فَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَاعَتَهُ: He obligated upon them his obedience
key_terms.هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى: Harun to Musa (reference to Quranic verse)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Prophet's statement to Ali: 'You are to me as Harun was to Musa'?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Jabir ibn Abdullah interprets the 'Harun from Musa' analogy as establishing Ali’s perpetual authority (Imamah) and obligatory obedience (Tawa') for the entire community, both during the Prophet's life and after his death. This interpretation underscores the Shia doctrine that the denial of Ali's explicit succession constitutes a form of injustice (Zulm), linking the prophetic declaration directly to the theological necessity of following the Imam.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Hasan bin Muhammed bin Sa’eed al-Hashimi in Kufa, that he said: We were told by Furat bin Ibrahim bin Furat al-Kufi, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Ali bin Mu’ammar, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Ali al-Ramli, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Musa, that he said: We were told by Ya’qoub bin Ishaq al-Maruzi, that he said: We were told by Amru bin Mansur, that he said: We were told by Isma’il bin Aban, from Yahya bin Kathir, from his father, from Abu Harun al-‘Abdi, that he said: I asked Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari

about the meaning of the saying of the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, to Ali, peace be upon him: You are to me in the same position as Harun to Musa, except that there is no Prophet after me. He said: He declared him as a Successor by that, by Allah, over his nation during his life and after his demise, and he obligated upon them his obedience. Hence, the one who does not testify for him, after this saying, Successorship, then he is among the wrongdoers.
